story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Founded in 2023, Reiboreal embodies the essence of 'Real'. We believe true beauty stems from dedication to craftsmanship and attention to detail.

After traveling the world, our founder was captivated by handcrafted arts across different cultures, inspiring the creation of a brand that perfectly blends traditional craftsmanship with modern design.
Each Reiboreal piece is meticulously designed and handcrafted. We don't pursue mass production; instead, we focus on creating unique jewelry for every customer.
